description: The figure is a rendered table (not a curve plot), despite the caption referring to a "variation". It tabulates crystallite size and lattice micro-strain for Fe-6.8Al samples under three processing conditions. A merged header row reads "Sample condition" spanning three columns: "98% CR", "750 °C, 5 min" and "750 °C, 60 min". The first row is "Crystallite size (nm)" with a single entry, 102.3 ± 9.8, under 98% CR and dashes ("-") under both 750 °C conditions, indicating the value was not determined or not reported there. The second row is "Micro-strain", giving 1.46 × 10⁻³ for 98% CR, 9.46 × 10⁻⁴ for 750 °C, 5 min, and 1.46 × 10⁻⁴ for 750 °C, 60 min. Thus micro-strain decreases monotonically with annealing time, dropping by one order of magnitude from 98% CR to the 60 min anneal, while crystallite size is only reported for the cold-rolled 98% CR state. There are no axes, scale bars or plotted symbols; all information is in table cells. The table provides the XRD-derived microstructural parameters used alongside the paper's strengthening-mechanism analysis.

observations.observation: The figure is a tabular listing of XRD-derived parameters, not a plotted curve, even though the caption calls it a 'variation'.
Column headers are the three sample conditions: '98% CR', '750 °C, 5 min' and '750 °C, 60 min', under a merged header 'Sample condition'.
Crystallite size is given only for '98% CR' as 102.3 ± 9.8 nm; the cells for '750 °C, 5 min' and '750 °C, 60 min' contain a dash ('-').
Micro-strain is 1.46 × 10⁻⁴ for '750 °C, 60 min', the lowest of the three conditions.
Micro-strain decreases monotonically with increasing annealing (98% CR > 750 °C, 5 min > 750 °C, 60 min), dropping by about one order of magnitude from the cold-rolled state to the 60 min anneal.
The caption states the table concerns 'Variation of crystallite size and lattice micro-strain for Fe-6.8Al samples in different conditions'.
No crystallite size value is reported for either 750 °C annealed condition, so the crystallite-size trend across conditions cannot be read from this figure.

subfigures.description: A single framed table with columns 'Sample condition' (98% CR, 750 °C, 5 min, 750 °C, 60 min) and rows 'Crystallite size (nm)' and 'Micro-strain'. Crystallite size = 102.3 ± 9.8 nm for 98% CR only (dashes for the other two). Micro-strain = 1.46 × 10⁻³ (98% CR), 9.46 × 10⁻⁴ (750 °C, 5 min) and 1.46 × 10⁻⁴ (750 °C, 60 min).
